goal_context.parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL; use exact WoWSims dummy evidence for class diagnosis.
goal_context.current_plan: Continue the coordinator graph through diagnosis, repair, independent review, build, live validation and publication while keeping all open actor, comparison and raid requirements visible.

objective: Make non-comparable tank and healer reference conditions explicit through the role harness and phase-8 aggregate contract, while retaining a real numerical floor for comparable records and keeping Blood actor acceptance open.
first_broken_edge: role_calibration:phase8 hard-floor aggregation treated an explicitly non-comparable tank/healer reference as a failed numerical floor.
forbidden_changes: No WoWSims/reference data, Blood SQL, native comparator, coefficients, gear, encounter behavior, route or safety policy changes.
No actor or raid acceptance from this contract result.
No removal of Heart Strike fallback or multi-target Blood Boil behavior.
acceptance_conditions: An incompatible tank/healer record reports reference_conditions_not_comparable and does not report reference_hard_floor as its cause.
The role result remains non-passing, while hard-floor aggregation and optimization backlog logic treat the reference floor as not applicable.
A comparable tank record still applies the configured numerical floor and a below-floor comparable record fails it.
Threat aura, healer exposure, damage smoothing, defensive coverage and all other tank-specific checks remain enforced.
proposed_change: Propagate hard_floor_applicable into compact phase-8 campaign results and exclude inapplicable references from aggregate hard-floor failure and optimization backlog calculations, with executable regression coverage.
acceptance_claim: The bounded Python contract change is implemented and its focused tests pass; live Blood behavior, actor performance and raid acceptance remain unproved.
observations: An incompatible record now omits the reference_hard_floor check failure, retains reference_comparison_eligible=false, and remains non-passing through that eligibility check.
Comparable records retain the existing numerical floor and below-floor behavior.
Phase-8 compact results now carry hard_floor_applicable; run and aggregate summaries count only applicable floor failures and backlog entries.
The focused contract test covers incompatible references, comparable passing and failing references, all tank-specific checks, and aggregate applicability semantics.
No Blood SQL or native gameplay file changed.

evidence_excerpts.excerpt: Non-comparable non-DPS references skip the reference_hard_floor check while preserving the explicit eligibility failure and role checks.
Compact campaign rows retain hard_floor_passed and now carry hard_floor_applicable for state summaries.
Aggregate hard-floor qualification treats explicitly inapplicable references as non-failing without changing the role result.
The regression covers all listed tank safety checks, comparable pass/fail floors, and phase-8 aggregation semantics.
